entries.1360ac6c4947cf85: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, gross profit was ¥30,625 million (up 17.7% year on year), selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥20,882 million (up 9.3% year on year), operating profit was ¥9,743 million (up 40.8% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥8,947 million (up 18.9% year on year), and profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥5,598 million (up 16.5% year on year). entries.29716ffa4b7f6a62: These are the main products of Oba Seiken Co., Ltd., a domestic consolidated subsidiary. It has its head office and production base in Aichi Prefecture and specializes in manufacturing high-precision, high-definition ground parts for manufacturing equipment components in the semiconductor, automotive and industrial machinery fields. In particular, the securities report states that the nozzle parts for its main product, chip mounters (surface-mount machines), are recognized for their high technical capability and contribute to the revenue of the company group. Building on its precision machining technology, it is also advancing efforts to make prototype parts and small-lot mass-produced products for automobiles a second pillar of its business.

The securities report states that, as a result of focusing on M&A and business investment in manufacturing in recent years, the share of manufacturing in profit has risen sharply, and a new corporate group combining trading functions and manufacturing is taking shape.
